name: iso-week-year
description: ISO 8601 week-numbering year expressed as a week-based definition: year starts on the Monday nearest 1 January, numbered with year_number 'majority'. Locate on 28 December and 4 January for every year 1600-2399, and on 1 January and 31 December (which can fall in the neighbouring ISO year) for 1970-2069. Week and year labels and their parse for 2015-2030. Expected year numbers, week index, week bounds, year bounds, year length, day of week and labels come from Python's date.isocalendar() and date.fromisocalendar(), not from the fiscalclock arithmetic. expect_subset is applied recursively: a nested object lists only the keys it asserts.

source.citation: Python standard library date.isocalendar() and date.fromisocalendar()
